ym_instance.label: Yandex Music account
ym_instance.description: The configured Yandex Music provider instance whose account Ynison uses. To use another Yandex account, configure another Yandex Music instance first.

mass_player_id.label: [%key:common::config_entries::mass_player_id::label%]
mass_player_id.description: The Music Assistant player connected to this Ynison plugin. Its current name is advertised in Yandex Music, and playback is always directed to this player unless manual switching is enabled.

allow_player_switch.label: Allow manual player switching
allow_player_switch.description: When enabled, you can select this plugin as a source on any player to switch playback to that player. When disabled, playback is fixed to the configured default player.

stream_mode.label: Stream mode
stream_mode.description: Stable keeps one PCM format for uninterrupted playback. Maximum quality (dynamic) follows each track's native PCM and restarts the source only when the effective player format changes. Dynamic mode requires Yandex Music Superb quality and Auto output format settings.

output_sample_rate.label: Output sample rate
output_sample_rate.description: Sample rate for PCM output to the player. 'Auto' starts at 44.1 kHz and adapts to the real track format and target player when available.

output_bit_depth.label: Output bit depth
output_bit_depth.description: Bit depth for PCM output to the player. 'Auto' selects 16-bit for lossy or 24-bit for lossless sources.

user.title: Configure Yandex Music Connect
user.description: Choose the linked Yandex Music account and the target Music Assistant player. The player's current name is published to the Yandex Music app.

abort.no_players: No players are available yet. Add a player to Music Assistant first, then try again.
abort.missing_dependency: Configure and authenticate a Yandex Music provider before adding or reconfiguring Ynison.

errors.no_connected_player: No connected Music Assistant player is configured. Run setup again to select one.

manifest.description: Makes a Music Assistant player appear as a device in the Yandex Music app via the Ynison protocol.
